item.title: The Philippines: Advancing Digital Competence Nationwide
item.description: These key upskilling initiatives in Mindoro and Aurora are equipping families and government employees with essential digital skills to improve financial resilience, workplace efficiency and secure online practices.

item.title: Hong Kong: Joint Centre to Advance Healthy Ageing, Smart Care
item.description: Hong Kong Polytechnic University and the University of Toronto have partnered to advance research in healthy ageing and AgeTech, developing health, rehabilitation and assistive solutions for ageing populations.

item.title: Vietnam’s First National Supercomputer Powers AI Innovation
item.description: Vietnam has launched its first national supercomputer, boosting domestic AI capabilities, supporting large-scale model development and advancing the country’s digital transformation and innovation ambitions.

item.title: Singapore: Hands-On Training to Strengthen Public Digital Resilience
item.description: Singapore is piloting the National Simulated Scams Exercise to empower all citizens, especially the elderly, to recognise, respond to and protect themselves against evolving online and digital scams.

item.title: Malaysia, India Deepen Digital and Semiconductor Cooperation
item.description: India and Malaysia plan to deepen cooperation in the digital economy and semiconductor sectors, supporting technology-led growth, resilient supply chains and advanced manufacturing.

item.title: Hong Kong: PolyU Advances Emotionally Intelligent AI Robots
item.description: Researchers at the Hong Kong Polytechnic University found that combining music with empathetic speech enhances social robots’ perceived emotional intelligence, improving human–robot bonds and engagement over repeated interactions

item.title: India: Amaravati Quantum Valley Advances Quantum Leadership
item.description: India launches Amaravati Quantum Valley under its US$720M National Quantum Mission, positioning the state as a strategic springboard for global quantum leadership, innovation and technological advancement.

item.title: Australia: Victoria Digital Birth Certificate Pilot Enhances Family Services
item.description: Victoria has begun a trial allowing parents in three councils to securely access and store their child’s birth certificate digitally via the Service Victoria app, simplifying administrative processes

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Innovation Powers Growth in Publishing Sector
item.description: Vietnam’s publishing industry is embracing digital transformation in 2026, leveraging e-books, AI and multimedia to modernise production, expand readership and strengthen global competitiveness.

item.title: Singapore: Sustainable 3D Concrete Printing for Smarter Construction
item.description: Singapore researchers advance sustainable 3D concrete printing, significantly cutting labour, materials and emissions while accelerating digital, automated construction processes on worksites.
